# design.md - Meridian Analytics

Extracted DNA from meridian.example.com (brand study, v1.1).
Macrostructure: split-hero with sticky rail. Fingerprint: editorial-restraint.

## Colour anchor

The brand runs a deep ink base with one saturated accent - never more.

- Ink: #1A1C1E
- Paper: #FAF9F6
- Accent: #C8553D
- Accent hover: #A94430
- Mist: rgb(226, 229, 233)

## Type pairing

- Display: Fraunces (serif, 600) - headlines only
- Body: Inter (400/500)
- family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

## Shape

Corners stay tight - radius: 4px on cards, 2px on inputs. No pill buttons.

## Macrostructure

Split hero, 12-col grid, sticky section rail, generous whitespace after the fold.

## Don'ts

- No gradients on brand surfaces
- No cards inside cards
- Never centre body copy
